run.decision: INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION. The frozen China-to-U.S. relay rule emitted nonzero U.S. target weights on 2452 combined sessions, but the actual intraday execution audit recorded zero round trips, zero realized intraday gross and unchanged initial cash. The formal performance series therefore represents only the cash path and cannot support any conclusion about the economic hypothesis. The defect is implementation plumbing: signal-only CSI300/Shanghai inputs were passed as execution assetInputs. No signal direction, threshold, asset, timing, allocation, fee, slippage or validation gate may be changed. A corrected successor may change only the plumbing so China series are read as external causal signals while execution assetInputs contain only Nasdaq and S&P 500.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not invert the China sign, change the two-index AND rule, add a return threshold, change signal lag, switch China or U.S. indices, add trend/volatility filters, change holding period, allocation, fee, slippage, or asset deletion inside this trial. Any such idea is a new independent preregistered strategy lineage.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have combined Sharpe > 0
with 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, combined CAGR > 0 and Sharpe > 0
maximum intraday gross <=100%, minimum end-of-day cash >=0 and overnight position days =0
methodology.selection_metric: No within-family selection. There is exactly one China-breadth continuation rule. Strategy validation, objective attainment and matched-control comparison are reported separately under ATM-SVP-3.

run.title: INDEPENDENT_CHINA_TO_US_INTRADAY_RISK_ON_RELAY_V1

strategies.description: A broad positive China cash-session close, observed before the U.S. cash open on the same calendar date, reflects globally persistent risk-on information and capital-flow sentiment that carries into the subsequent U.S. cash session. Buying Nasdaq and S&P 500 at the U.S. open only after both CSI300 and Shanghai Composite close higher should produce a repeatable positive open-to-close return without overnight exposure.

version.mechanism_text: A broad positive China cash-session close, observed before the U.S. cash open on the same calendar date, reflects globally persistent risk-on information and capital-flow sentiment that carries into the subsequent U.S. cash session. Buying Nasdaq and S&P 500 at the U.S. open only after both CSI300 and Shanghai Composite close higher should produce a repeatable positive open-to-close return without overnight exposure.

allowed_changes: one fixed cross-market rule: if both same-calendar-date completed CSI300 and Shanghai Composite closes are above their immediately preceding real-session closes, enter U.S. equity exposure at that date's U.S. cash open
trade Nasdaq and S&P 500 as standalone 100% sleeves and as one fixed 50/50 combined portfolio
exit every U.S. position at the same U.S. session close; hold no overnight position
matched availability controls trade the identical U.S. open-to-close paths on every date where the two China signal bars and U.S. execution bars exist, but ignore the sign of China returns
one fixed 0.05% adverse-slippage-per-fill stress in addition to the 0.005% per-fill fee
forbidden_changes: reading current U.S. session high, low or close before the U.S. open entry decision
using any China observation timestamped after the U.S. cash open
testing positive, negative, thresholded or weighted China-return variants and selecting the best
changing same-day China breadth from the fixed CSI300 AND Shanghai Composite positive-close rule
adding SMA, ATR, RSI, MACD, volume, VIX, NFCI or any other filter after viewing the result
changing same-day U.S. close exit to overnight or multi-day holding
asset-specific parameters or dropping a weak Nasdaq or S&P 500 path
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, negative target weights, gross exposure above 100% or negative end-of-day cash
changing the 0.005% per-fill fee or hiding the preregistered adverse-slippage stress

shared_rules.china_signal: same calendar date CSI300 close > prior real CSI300 close AND Shanghai Composite close > prior real Shanghai close
shared_rules.entry: buy current U.S. session real open after the completed same-date China cash closes are known
shared_rules.time_causality: China cash close precedes U.S. cash open on the same calendar date
